title: Mưa trên kính (piano, cello, viola)
about: Round 18: mua-tren-kinh's tune (round 15, an octave up as in round 16) for piano, cellos and violas, as the user asked ("hãy thử piano + cello + viola: piano chơi chính, cello đáp câu, viola chỉ giữ nền mỏng"): the piano on the tune alone, the cellos answering it where it holds or rests (the bass, held, where there is no tune), the violas one thin line under it; an original tune.
